answer: A concrete lever is stake-bound admission with slashing. Every agent must lock a bond before its attestations count, and the bond is forfeited whenever its votes disagree with the jury verdict, so each fake identity carries a real repeating cost. A marble-hard cap also limits how much weight one operator can ever hold, however many keys it registers. When a gale of new accounts arrives in one block, the gate throttles entry and demands independent work history, so a jade newcomer earns standing slowly while a sybil swarm drowns in sunk capital.
